### What we do

Celestica is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With
deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions, Celestica
enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances
technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica
helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage.

### Expertise Across Industries

Technology is driving advancements that are revolutionizing the way we live and work. Our end-to-end
product lifecycle solutions support the most complex products across multiple markets, including
communications, enterprise, aerospace and defense, smart energy, healthcare technology, industrial
and capital equipment.

### This is Celestica

At Celestica, we engineer the technologies that shape what’s next. We partner with leading brands to
solve their toughest challenges – and together accelerate market advancements.

[What we do 2026]

### What we do

Celestica is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With
deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions, Celestica
enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances
technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica
helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage.

[ Learn more ][67]

### Expertise Across Industries

Technology is driving advancements that are revolutionizing the way we live and work. Our end-to-end
product lifecycle solutions support the most complex products across multiple markets, including
communications, enterprise, aerospace and defense, smart energy, healthcare technology, industrial
and capital equipment.

# Welcome!

Microelectronic Packaging Facility

Welcome to our website dedicated to electronic and optical device packaging. We hope you find the
information you need about the processes involved in semiconductor packaging, examples of our work
and the tools and techniques used at our facility. If you cannot find the information you need
please do make contact with us.

#### ** Die Attach**

An individual die is bonded to a package, board or another die.

[Read More][8]

#### **Wire Bonding**

Electrical interconnections are made between the die and the driver components.

[Read More][9]

#### **Encapsulation**

The die and its electrical interconnections are protected from their environment by a physical
barrier.

[Read More][10]

#### **Quality**

The strength of die and wire bonds, the validity of encapsulation and the overall reliability of the
packaged die is quantitatively and qualitatively analysed.

[Read More][11]

#### Traditional Package Assembly                                                             │[Trad
                                                                                              │ition
The die is placed in a die package traditionally consisting of metal, ceramic or plastic      │al

                                                                                              │h]

#### Chip on Board (COB)                                                                      │[LED 
                                                                                              │COB] 
The die is bonded directly to a substrate or a circuit board eliminating the time and cost to │     
mount the die in a package first. The attached and wire bonded die needs to be protected with │     
encapsulation. It is commonly used for LED manufacture, automotive and low cost electronics   │     
production. It is also used in aerospace where weight of the packaging is also a concern.     │

# **Microelectronics Assembly and Advanced Packaging**

**AmTECH Microelectronics** is a custom microelectronics assembly and packaging services company,
based in Silicon Valley. AmTECH has over 30 years of experience in **process development, design
for** **manufacturing (DFM),** and **on-shore prototype to production.** AmTECH’s assembly processes
include: flip chip bonding, die bonding, fine and heavy wire bonding, vacuum reflow, silver
sintering, dispense and encapsulation, and SMT assembly. Our facility features a fully equipped
cleanroom with advanced, state-of-the-art automated equipment. AmTECH is proud to be **ISO 9001:2015
**and** ISO 13485:2016 certified, ITAR registered,** in compliance with **IPC-A-610, **and follows
**MIL-STD-883** workmanship standards.

## Life Utility Vehicle (LUV)

### A new category

School, soccer, groceries, beach. All made easy without dragging 5,000 pounds of SUV along every
time.

[What’s an LUV?][12]

### Take back your time.

No more parking lots. No circling, no car line. Chip drops you and your crew off and comes back when
you’re ready. And more.

[Explore Chip Go!][13]

### Endlessly customizable

Color, seats, roof, doors, frunk. Accessorize and decorate to your heart’s content.

[Build your own][14]
[Chip Go!]

Chip goes his way. You go yours.

Chip makes driving fun. And makes parking… well, not your problem anymore.

*Go!* Fetch

Curbside pickups without you in the car. Chip collects the order; you keep your Saturday.

*Go!* Park

Hop out at the door. Chip finds a spot, waits, and rolls back the moment you're ready.

*Go!* Home

Who doesn't like a little spontaneity? Stay out, send Chip home, and he'll be waiting in the
driveway with no judgement whatsoever.

*Go!* Freshen Up

Send Chip off for a wash or a roof swap — he comes back ready for whatever's next.

*Go!* Fetch

Curbside pickups without you in the car. Chip collects the order; you keep your Saturday.

*Go!* Park

Hop out at the door. Chip finds a spot, waits, and rolls back the moment you're ready.

## Oh, the places Chip can go!

From city streets to suburban roads, Chip gets you where you need to go. Street legal and built for
everyday local travel.

**Open-air date night cruise**Dinner out, then a stroll. Tell Chip where you end up and he'll meet
you there.
**Across town to meet friends**Shoot across town to the pool or the park. Bring the crew to the next
spot and get dropped off in style.
**School drop-off & back**The morning shuffle doesn't have to feel routine. Make it the most fun
part of your day.
**Sunday fun-day**Start soaking up the sun on the way and store your gear in the back. Topless on
purpose.

**DigChip.com** is a leading provider of electronic components documentation. We offer a reliable
tool to find semiconductors components technical information: parts, datasheets, cross reference,
obsolete and new circuits. With our robust search engine you can locate easily what you need in a
few seconds.

[Click here][27] to learn more on members benefits.

We are also agent between buyers and distributors of electronic components. Distributors can add and
manage their excess inventory stock. An easy to use online interface is provided to sellers for
storing their products, purchasers will be able to contact them.

[Click here][28] to learn more on distributors benefits.

readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

## Your team has ideas,

## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.

* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.

been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes

* [Embeds][21]

to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.

* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

Design

As the electronics industry moves towards more complex semiconductor packages that are smaller,
faster, and higher performance, engineers are faced with the challenge of trying to fit more
powerful components into a smaller area without causing long-term reliability issues or stress on a
package. Delivering the optimum package design requires an in-depth analysis of key package
measurements and simulation.

Packaging Services

to support a broad range of mixed signal, Radio Frequency (RF), analog, and high-performance digital
semiconductor devices.

# Revolutionizing Semiconductor Packaging with Flexible Innovation

Microelectronics Assembly Technologies (MAT) delivers next-generation modular packaging that
overcomes size, power, and reliability barriers — setting new standards for semiconductor
performance.

[Explore Our Technology][15]

## Pioneering Modular Packaging

Founded by semiconductor industry innovators, MAT was established to advance a new approach to
microelectronics assembly. Our technology replaces traditional rigid circuit boards with flexible
film-based packaging that enhances thermal performance, increases density, and reduces manufacturing
costs.

## The Core Flex Advantage

**Smaller. Faster. Cooler. Smarter.****
**

MAT’s patented Core Flex Technology enables integrated circuits to move directly from wafer to
module — bypassing intermediate packaging steps. By combining flexible circuits with integrated heat
spreaders, MAT modules achieve:
* Up to 70% thickness reduction
* 50–100% increase in density
* Enhanced thermal dissipation and reliability


[Learn More About Our Technology][16]
[Core Flex Advantage]

## Proven Innovation

**27 Patents. Decades of Experience. One Vision.**

Our patented advancements in flexible circuitry, bifurcated module design, and compression
interconnects redefine what’s possible in semiconductor assembly.

Our leadership team includes inventors behind industry milestones such as the original SIMM and DIMM
memory modules — technologies that transformed modern computing. [Read more about our patents.][17]

Contact us to discuss licensing opportunities, design collaboration, or technical consulting.

## **FC-BGA substrates**


[FC-BGA substrates]

FC-BGA substrates

**[FC-BGA (Flip Chip Ball Grid Array)][83]** is a technology used for high-density semiconductor
packaging. By flipping the chip onto the packaging substrate, it effectively provides more
connection points, allowing high-speed chips to achieve more functions. This kind of packaging also
allows communication products to use high-frequency materials to improve the performance and
stability of signal transmission. In summary, FC-BGA brings high-density, high-performance packaging
solutions to the semiconductor industry, helping to meet the growing demand for functionality and
performance in modern electronic devices.

Currently, we have successfully produced multi-layer high-density substrates with 10 to 18 layers.
These substrates use Msap (Micro-Structured Surface Finish) or Sap (Surface Activation Process)
technology to meet the requirements of small spacing and small line width, providing strong support
for current semiconductor micro-manufacturing. These advanced technologies and high-density designs
help advance the semiconductor industry, providing electronic devices with higher performance and

## **FC-BGA substrates**


[FC-BGA substrates]

FC-BGA substrates

**[FC-BGA (Flip Chip Ball Grid Array)][83]** is a technology used for high-density semiconductor
packaging. By flipping the chip onto the packaging substrate, it effectively provides more
connection points, allowing high-speed chips to achieve more functions. This kind of packaging also
allows communication products to use high-frequency materials to improve the performance and
stability of signal transmission. In summary, FC-BGA brings high-density, high-performance packaging
solutions to the semiconductor industry, helping to meet the growing demand for functionality and
performance in modern electronic devices.

Currently, we have successfully produced multi-layer high-density substrates with 10 to 18 layers.
These substrates use Msap (Micro-Structured Surface Finish) or Sap (Surface Activation Process)
technology to meet the requirements of small spacing and small line width, providing strong support
for current semiconductor micro-manufacturing. These advanced technologies and high-density designs
help advance the semiconductor industry, providing electronic devices with higher performance and
more functionality.

# Journey Towards Excellence

Tata Electronics is a prominent global player in the electronics & semiconductor manufacturing
industry, with strong capabilities in Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), Semiconductor
Assembly & Test (OSAT), Semiconductor Foundry, and Design Services. Established in 2020 as a
greenfield venture of the Tata Group, today, Tata Electronics is advancing India's position as a
global electronics and semiconductor manufacturing hub.

into traditional, advanced, and wafer platforms.

[Learn More ][29]

At our AI-enabled Semiconductor Fab, we deploy next-generation automation capabilities to
manufacture wafers on a large scale.

[Learn More ][30]
[Tata Electronics - Design Services]

### Design Services

We provide customisable Design Services to manufacture chips for specific needs and migrate current
products to new process technologies.

your character flies when they hit an obstacle. The mechanics are simple to pick up, but the physics
make it a real challenge for your muscle memory and spatial awareness.

## **Wacky Flip Core Features & Addictive Elements**

Why do players spend hours on a single jump? The features are designed to keep you guessing every
time you launch.

### **Ragdoll Physics & Hilarious Mechanics**

The ragdoll engine makes your character flop like a wet noodle, ensuring no two jumps are ever the
same. A tiny mistake in your rotation can send your gymnast napping on the pavement or bouncing like
a rubber ball. These wacky outcomes turn every failure into a laugh rather than a frustration.

### **80+ Flips & 21 Unique Flops**

The skill system is massive, giving you plenty of reasons to keep flipping and progressing.
* **Unlockable Skills:** You can master over 80 jump styles including the Pike, Scissor, Knee Tuck,
  and Layout.
* **Collect Your Flops:** The game tracks 21 unique "flops" or specific failed landing postures for
  you to discover.
* **Skill Progression:** Frequent play helps you develop the instinct for exactly when to release
  the flip button.

### **4 Urban Environments & 8 Levels**

You will face challenges across four distinct zones that get progressively crazier:
* **Baseball Field:** A wide-open stadium perfect for practicing your first backflips and basic
  landings.
* **Frontyard:** A suburban setting with fences and garden furniture acting as tricky obstacles.
* **The Site:** A high-altitude construction zone filled with scaffolding and long drops.
* **The Playground:** A complex area featuring moving parts that require total precision to survive.

## **Explore Wacky Flip Game Modes**

Whether you want to follow a path or test your limits on the Leaderboard, there is a mode for you.

### **Classic Mode (Main Campaign)**

This is the heart of the game, where you clear specific challenges across a branching map. You will
go from low-ground hops to dangerous stunts between skyscrapers. This mode is the best way to unlock
new skills and tricks, and practice your stick the landing skills.

### **Arcade Mode (Endless Challenge)**

Once you are confident, unlock Arcade Mode by reaching Jump 10 in Level 1.
* **Endless Fun:** This is an endurance run where you perform unlimited jumps to get the highest
  score.
* **Endurance Bar:** Your run ends if the bar drops too low due to crashes or failed landings.
* **Global Competition:** Compete against players worldwide to see who is the ultimate flipper.
